name: Misaki Renka
source:
She has an oddly clean and straightforward personality. At first glance, she may seem blunt.

In real life, she is trying to make herself look like a “big sister”. In the end, she always destroys things herself.

She is always in her serious Tetuko mode.

She is a very passionate person.

Nickname Online: ＴＥＴＵＫＯ(´∀｀)
Occupation: Voice actress /  self - proclaimed healer
Comprehension skills: "Naichichi Complex"
Three Sizes: "Shut up, you're annoying!" (it's a personal issue) ※ Bust size 80 cm (well, it really is 79,5 cm)
